target_facts: uniques[].bases[].base_items[] — target BaseItemTypes physical row and stable Id, plus ItemClasses.Id through BaseItemTypes.ItemClass, joined by exact Name equality to the vendor base text. Name equality verifies the vendor text names a real target base; it is not an official unique->base link.
retained_vendor: uniques[].mods[] text, rolls, variant/version/group/tags/flags/annotations and grants_skill convenience parse
uncertified: An official unique->base link: the PoE2 client has no unique item definition table; the vendor base name is community curation verified only by Name equality.
Unique->mods/roll/variant assignment: mod lists, roll ranges, variants and selection are server-side game data retained as pinned vendor text.

grants_skill links to ModGrantedSkills/SkillGems/GrantedEffects: the emitted grants_skill object is a structural text parse, not a verified game relation; the item-grants domain and a SkillGemsForUniqueStat supplement remain the path for verified skill grants.

statement: Explicit fixed community unique catalog interpretation. The pinned source is the retained-compatibility member 0.5.5.5/overlay/uniques.json of the published game part, produced from PathOfBuilding-PoE2 vendor text by PoBR's sync-pob-catalog extractor. This domain projects that text into a structured unique->base->mods/roll/variant relation without re-certifying it: only the exact-Name base resolution reads target facts, and unresolved/ambiguous names are recorded diagnostics rather than failures or guesses.
